title: Horizontal Range of a Projectile
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: A projectile is fired with initial speed v_0 = 98 m/s at an angle of 30 degrees to the horizontal. Assuming g = 9.8 m/s^2, find its horizontal range.

steps.title: Find Total Time of Flight
steps.explanation: Set vertical displacement y(T) = 0 and solve for non-zero time.

steps.title: Compute Horizontal Distance Travelled
steps.explanation: Multiply constant horizontal velocity by flight duration.
